matter how many times a phone, I never ever look forward to phoning this practice. Its not the doctors, doctors are brilliant, it's the reception staff. I always phone with a nice friendly manner, but what you get back from them is a joke, and a bit unprofessional to be fairly honest. As you can see am not the only person who feels this way. It's a hit or a miss whether you get someone who actually sounds like they like their job. They can't say I was aggressive or abrupt with them, so they have no right to be unpleasant with me or any of the other patients, and they are, so they wonder why patients get annoyed. They say they don't take inappropriate behaviour from the patients towards their staff, but what about the way they speak to patients, its not right, and something has to be done about it now with this practice. There is only one lassie in that practice, and it's the young lassie, she's so pleasant, a think she could give them a lessons or 2 on great customer service, and a professional telephone manner. If you don't like your job, working in a GP practice isn't where you should be working.

Working in a GP practice is only hard if you make it hard, and if you can't be bothered to approach patients with compassion and professionalism, then this isn't a role for you. I loved my time working within the GP services, and A&E, and yes you do get alot of pressure at times, but that's the joys of this kind of job, its demanding but rewarding as well. Of course you don't take abuse, no one should at their work, and i am glad they have this approach for all their staff, but that doesnt mean you can treat patients like dirt when you can't be bothered to give the right information or you can't be bothered to do the job. I know what goes behind the scenes of a GP surgery, so am sorry, a cant be bothered with they have a heavy workload, think of a nurse working in a busy A&E working 12 hours, sometimes don't get away, and don't get a meal throughout their shift, now that's hard work. I worked in an Edinburgh GP practice, and you take the good with the bad, its the way things are in the health service, your going to get patients that get upset and annoyed, but at the end of the day, it shouldn't be taken personally, the real reason patients are upset is because they are ill, and on many occasions I've not had a great service from this practice. So please before you start saying they have a hard job, it's only hard if they make it that way....

On the happier note, the new triage system is really good, so that's great 👍 so well done with that, and the doctors/Nurses, midwives, and health visitor are amazing, for me that's the only thing keeping me there. It's always unpleasant though speaking to the reception
